alt: 家人提著行李在門口等候，一人看著手錶，另一人只穿好一隻鞋，仍伸手挑圍巾、說個不停。
scene_prompt: A modern doorway departure scene communicates indecision and long-winded delaying: a family with coats and packed bags waits impatiently beside the open front door, one checking a wristwatch with a blank face. A hesitant adult who is supposed to leave keeps speaking with raised finger while half putting on one shoe, then reaching back toward a scarf and other choices on a chair; visibly no progress and exasperated listeners. No mud, no speech bubbles or words.
